items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: When Krupa was there, I marched out and sat down on the drums by him.

ctx.x: Well, when I got to New York and I was still playing all those instruments, I used to go into a theater like the Apollo, and Savoy Bar Room, and when different guest bands came in the Savoy Bar Room, whoever the band leader was, if he was playing trombone or saxophone or drums, I used to have a tune that I used to play and go around the band and play different instruments. And when I got to the instrument the leader was playing, just having fun you know, with the leader because we was all good friends, I'd play…

That was during the time of Dorsey, Basie, well, all the big bands, Bunny Berigan, Krupa. When Krupa was there, I marched out and sat down on the drums by him. Now, you know, I had some nerve. You know. (Laughter) (Inaudible).
So, Mr. Foster was actually your first teacher?
